ops.text: 9.7 Materials Warranty. Array warrants that all Materials supplied by or on behalf of Array to Ono under this Agreement will, at the time of delivery and through the expiration of the applicable shelf life or retest date, (a) conform in all material respects to the applicable product specifications and the certificate of analysis for the relevant batch, and (b) have been Manufactured in accordance with GMP and all other applicable Law. Array further warrants that it shall perform its obligations under this Agreement in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards. For any Materials that fail to conform to the foregoing warranty, Array shall, at Ono's election, promptly replace such Materials at no additional cost to Ono or refund the amounts paid by Ono for such Materials, in each case together with any shipping, handling and destruction costs incurred by Ono.

input.comment: [Playbook] Array supplies Drug Substance and Drug Product but gives no conformance warranty or remedy, so we added a specifications/GMP warranty for Materials with replacement or refund, consistent with our playbook position that the supplier stands behind its work. We can accept a shorter warranty window tied to shelf life if that better matches Array's upstream supply terms.
input.summary: Insert a Materials conformance/GMP warranty with replace-or-refund remedy as new Section 9.7.
